extension.summary: Curated movie/show widgets for Arctic Fuse, sourced from MDBList, Jellyfin favourites or your local library
extension.description: Live-resolves curated lists against your local Kodi library via JSON-RPC and exposes each one as its own independently-addressable widget: exact-ordered lists (Trending Movies, MCU chronological order, Star Wars order, Best Picture Winners), a Trending Shows widget, "Want to Watch Movies" and "Want to Watch Shows" built from your Jellyfin favourites, and date-windowed ones (Christmas, Halloween, Valentine's Day, May the 4th, Star Trek Day, Nick November, Friday the 13th) that return empty outside their window so the skin's auto-hide takes care of showing/hiding them. Watched status, resume points and episode counts come through from your library, so widget items look the same as the ones in Kodi's own views. The Want to Watch widgets need no API key and no setup -- they reuse the login your Jellyfin addon already stores on that box. New lists can be added from the addon's own settings screen (label, type, URL, optional window) without redeploying, and no external cron job or file share is required.
extension.news:
v2.5.0 (2026-08-26) - BREAKING: widget URLs changed. Lists are now ?list=<name> and actions ?mode=<name>. The old ?key=<name> is removed, so any widget using it must be repointed to ?list=. - Added "Want to Watch Movies" and "Want to Watch Shows", built from your Jellyfin favourites. No API key or setup needed -- it reuses your Jellyfin addon's login. - Fixed: watched status, resume points and episode counts now show on widget items. - Fixed: the watched-progress pie now appears on part-watched shows.
v2.0.9 (2026-08-16) - Version bump only; no functional changes.
v2.0.8 (2026-08-15) - List URLs now accept ?limit=N, capping the number of matched results. - Tidied up list rendering.
